- PAPER CHAIN KIT 50'S CHRISTMAS generated the highest revenue TW at £5.7k, followed by RABBIT NIGHT LIGHT at £5.1k and CHILLI LIGHTS at £5.0k.
- POPCORN HOLDER led unit sales TW with 2,955 units, while RABBIT NIGHT LIGHT achieved 2,331 units and PAPER CHAIN KIT 50'S CHRISTMAS sold 1,692 units.
- RABBIT NIGHT LIGHT received the most orders TW at 105, compared to PAPER CHAIN KIT 50'S CHRISTMAS with 96 orders and HOT WATER BOTTLE KEEP CALM with 73 orders.
- DOORMAT BLACK FLOCK showed the strongest WoW revenue growth at 1544.7%, followed by SET/3 VANILLA SCENTED CANDLE IN BOX at 1256.0% and COLOURED GLASS STAR T-LIGHT HOLDER at 1050.4%.
- JAM MAKING SET WITH JARS demonstrated exceptional YoY revenue growth of 832.5%, while WOODEN ADVENT CALENDAR RED grew 698.9% and ZINC FOLKART SLEIGH BELLS increased 591.9%.
- REGENCY CAKESTAND 3 TIER generated £3.5k revenue TW, placing it fourth among top revenue products.
- PAPER CHAIN KIT VINTAGE CHRISTMAS contributed £3.0k revenue TW with 1,043 units sold and 71 orders.
- ROTATING SILVER ANGELS T-LIGHT HLDR achieved 1,170 units sold TW, ranking fourth in unit volume.
